name: University of Bologna
summary: Public university in Bologna, Forlì, Rimini and Ravenna; eleven English degrees, most ranked on the SAT, each with its own EU places.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma: 24+ points with 12 at HL, TOK, EE and CAS passed; ask the IB to send your scores. Each degree ranks you on its own test: mostly the SAT, some CEnT-S or TOLC-E.

programmes.name: Building Construction Engineering
programmes.about: Between engineering and architecture: designing, building and restoring buildings, on an international programme taught entirely in English in Ravenna.
programmes.overview: The degree trains engineers who design, manage and oversee the production and use of buildings and infrastructure, with the technical and scientific skills of a construction engineer. Typical courses in this field include mathematics and physics, building technology, structures, materials and construction management, and teaching takes place in laboratories with modern equipment. The programme is taught entirely in English on the Ravenna campus and includes Erasmus and overseas exchange options. Graduates work as building designers and technicians who can also coordinate projects and teams as project managers, or continue to a master's degree or a first-level professional master's.
programmes.ib: Ranked on the CEnT-S test (first and second rounds); a possible extraordinary round uses the SAT. Most places are for non-EU applicants.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your weighted CEnT-S score. 30 EU places in each of the first two rounds. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Business and Economics
programmes.about: Business and economics in English in Bologna, using data and analytics to shape strategies for companies, institutions and communities; double-degree options.
programmes.overview: The guiding thread is strategic management, backed by the main business functions, with a focus on how companies grow in international markets. You learn to analyse consumer behaviour in consumer and industrial markets, the theory and techniques of competition and sector analysis, and financial, product and service markets, so that you can work in any business area and cooperate with the others. Data and analytics are used to build sustainable strategies, and double and multiple degrees are available. Graduates move into international managerial roles in consulting, business, non-profit, manufacturing and service companies, or continue to English-taught master's degrees in the School of Economics.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; ranked on SAT score alone, no minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 85 in round 1, 60 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 10 Feb–4 May; round 2 to 3 July; extra 3–11 Sep

programmes.name: Economics and Finance
programmes.about: Economics and finance taught entirely in English in Bologna, looking at how global markets work and what they mean locally.
programmes.overview: The first two years cover the basics of economics, and the third year turns to economics and finance, with specific sub-fields of economics, econometrics and finance courses. In the second and third years you can choose elective courses in economics, economic history, business, law, statistics and mathematics. Graduates are prepared to work as junior economic and financial analysts, giving advice to private and public bodies on investment and funding plans, evaluating securities and assessing financial risk, or to move on to economic journalism or to master's studies in economics, finance and management. Labs, internships and fieldwork grants are available.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; ranked on SAT score alone, no minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 50 in round 1, 40 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 10 Feb–4 May; round 2 to 3 July; extra 3–11 Sep

programmes.name: Economics of Tourism and Cities
programmes.about: Economics applied to tourist destinations and cities: analysing and rethinking strategies and policies for urban life and sustainable tourism, in Rimini.
programmes.overview: The first year gives a basis in mathematics, private law, political economy, economic history and geography, and business economics. The later years specialise in the legal governance of territory and tourism, statistics and mathematics for market research, economic models of tourism and cultural industries, urban, regional and transport economics, and marketing, financial analysis and corporate strategy, with digital skills for collecting data and communicating with tourists. Teaching includes labs, internships and a thesis. Graduates work as tourism and city development consultants, destination managers, tourism planners, hotel and hospitality managers, event organisers and economists in the public and private sector.
programmes.ib: SAT required (scores from 1 February 2024); ranked on SAT score alone.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 35 in round 1, 35 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Economics, Politics and Social Sciences
programmes.about: Economic, political and social questions in a globalised world, studied together in English in Bologna across economics and political science.
programmes.overview: A newer degree that trains you in the social sciences from both quantitative and qualitative angles, combining core teaching in economics and political science with statistics, management and law. You gain the quantitative skills for empirical analysis and the interpretive tools to understand complex economic, political and social settings, nationally and internationally, and the structure is tuned to the needs of the private sector and public administration. Statistics, programming and data analysis are in demand on the job market. Graduates work in international organisations, research centres, NGOs, internationally active companies, demographic institutes and news agencies, in roles such as policy and public-administration management.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; minimum eligible SAT score 1100.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score; 1100 is the minimum to be ranked. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 10 Feb–4 May; round 2 to 3 July; extra 3–11 Sep

programmes.name: Genomics
programmes.about: Biotechnology focused on the genome: investigating the biological bases and processes that regulate life, taught in English in Bologna.
programmes.overview: The degree applies computing, mathematics and statistics to genomic data. You start with mathematical analysis, algebra, physics and chemistry, then study genetics, biochemistry and the molecular biology of prokaryotes and eukaryotes, together with programming, statistics, algorithms, multi-scale modelling and computational simulation. Bioinformatics skills include analysing nucleic acids, proteins and omic datasets, mining and managing biological databases and the bioethics of sensitive data, complemented by a data science subject. Learning includes laboratory work, projects, internships and a thesis. Graduates can annotate and curate biological datasets and interpret omic data in systems biology, or continue to further study.
programmes.ib: SAT for the first round; later rounds use TOLC-I, which is in Italian.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score in round 1 (TOLC-I in Italian in later rounds). 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Studies
programmes.about: International relations for roles in peace, cooperation and sustainable development: how international systems work, taught in English in Forlì.
programmes.overview: The course gives a multidisciplinary training that is both theoretical and empirical, always with a comparative and international perspective. Economic, historical, legal and political analysis are used to understand the international system, with subjects such as comparative legal systems, international law and political science, plus two languages, and practical activities let you apply what you learn. You can take internships in international organisations and join exchange programmes, including Erasmus+ study and traineeship periods. Graduates are prepared for international roles and may continue to a second-cycle degree or a first-level professional master's.
programmes.ib: Round 1: TOLC-E (in Italian) plus English B2. Round 2: the SAT instead.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score: TOLC-E (minimum 8/36) in round 1, SAT in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 (TOLC-E) 3 Feb–29 Apr; round 2 (SAT) to 3 July

programmes.name: Management and Economics
programmes.about: Tools, methods and quantitative analysis to help companies compete on global markets, taught in English in Forlì with double-degree options.
programmes.overview: The programme centres on management and economics and adds foundations in law, mathematics and statistics seen from an international angle, together with Business English and Cross-Cultural Management. You study business and company law, accounting and financial statements under international standards, business strategy, how the financial system works, consumer behaviour, and microeconomic and macroeconomic theory, and you build data analysis skills. Exchanges for study and internships are available, and you can spend the last semester at the University of Bologna's campus in Buenos Aires. Double degrees exist, and the degree gives access to master's programmes.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; below 500 in SAT Math you get an extra maths obligation (OFA).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 35 in round 1, 20 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Pharmacy
programmes.about: A five-year pharmacy degree in English that combines science with patient contact, for work across the pharmaceutical supply chain.
programmes.overview: The five years move from chemistry, biology, anatomy and human physiology towards medicinal chemistry, pharmacology, toxicology and pharmaceutical technology, with added courses in bioethics, first aid, digital health and pharmaceutical and clinical care. The aim is to train pharmacists who can advise patients on medicines and health products such as cosmetics, food supplements and medical devices, take part in public health campaigns and act as a link between patient, doctor and health service. Internships and dissertation research abroad are possible. Graduates qualify as pharmacists after the state exam, or continue to specialisation schools, doctorates or second-level master's programmes.
programmes.ib: Ranked on the CEnT-S test (in English), taken by the call's deadlines.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your CEnT-S score. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery
programmes.about: A six-year medical degree taught entirely in English in Bologna, training doctors to practise in an international setting.
programmes.overview: Over six years taught in English, you move from the basic medical sciences, typically anatomy, physiology and biochemistry, to clinical medicine and practical training. The programme takes an international view, with attention to health promotion, preventive care, family health and global health, and an orientation that widens options for specialty training and research abroad. Graduates work as physicians in public and private clinics, hospitals and specialised medical centres, hospices, universities and research centres, and national and international health and humanitarian organisations, or go on to further education.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English: 60 questions on general knowledge, logic, biology, chemistry, physics and maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Places set nationally and filled by the admission test score. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine
programmes.about: A five-year veterinary degree in English: caring for animals to protect people and the environment, at the Ozzano dell'Emilia campus near Bologna.
programmes.overview: The programme integrates the veterinary subjects across the curriculum, with strong attention to One Health and Circular Health, and builds transversal and soft skills alongside clinical ones. Hands-on training takes place in laboratories, a clinical skills lab, the teaching hospital, a farm and external facilities, and in the final year you tailor your studies through electives and practical training. Teaching in English supports mobility through Erasmus, internships and dissertation work abroad. Veterinarians protect the health of animals, people and the environment, working in clinical care of pets and farm animals, in public health bodies, in research and in food production, or continue to postgraduate study.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English: 60 questions on general knowledge, logic, biology, chemistry, physics and maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Places set nationally and filled by the admission test score. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Every degree has its own call with two or three rounds and separate EU places; the 2027-28 calls are not out yet (in 2026 the SAT degrees opened on 10 February).
As an EU applicant you apply on Studenti Online and pay a small fee (€20 in 2026); Universitaly pre-enrolment is only for non-EU applicants who need a visa.
Two more English degrees are admitted by partners: Biology of Human and Environmental Health through Padua, European Studies through KU Leuven.
